validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition target="b"/>
  </state>
  <state id="b">
    <transition target="a"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: unconditional eventless transition cycle: a -> b -> a
notes: eventless, conditionless transitions are taken immediately in the same macrostep; a cycle of them never reaches a stable configuration (a warning: SCXML 1.0 Appendix D says a macrostep that does not terminate "is currently allowed", so the document is conforming and compiles, and a host bounds the run)
diagnostics.help: add an event or condition to one transition, or remove a target so the macrostep can reach a stable configuration
